epq_reduction: AAB including A in Maths with A in EPQ/IPQ/ASCC
additional_conditions: Where a Science A level is taken, a pass in the practical science element is required. EPQ/IPQ/Welsh Bac ASCC grade A may reduce offer to AAB including A in Maths.
document_text: Leeds A level entry requires AAA including Mathematics. Where a Science A level is taken, a pass in the practical science element is required alongside the stated grade. Applicants offering grade A in EPQ, IPQ or Welsh Baccalaureate ASCC may receive an offer of AAB including A in Mathematics. GCSE English Language minimum grade 4/C required. Level 2 Functional Skills English also accepted.

subject_required: 30 credits at Distinction including Maths modules. Further Maths required.
additional_conditions: Pass 60 credits overall with 45 at Level 3. 30 credits at Distinction including appropriate Maths modules. Remaining 15 credits at Merit or above.
document_text: Leeds Access to HE Diploma entry requires passing 60 credits overall with 45 credits at Level 3, including 30 credits at Distinction (including an appropriate number of Mathematics modules) and the remaining 15 credits at Merit or above. GCSE English Language minimum grade 4/C required.

subject_required: Distinctions in all Mathematics units. Further Mathematics unit required.
additional_conditions: Distinctions in all Mathematics units required. Further Mathematics unit must be included even if optional on the BTEC course.
document_text: Leeds BTEC Extended Diploma entry requires D*D*D with Distinctions in all Mathematics units. Further Mathematics must be included as a unit even if it is optional on the BTEC course. GCSE English Language minimum grade 4/C required.
Leeds Cambridge Pre-U entry requires D3, D3, D3 in Principal Subjects including Mathematics. GCSE English Language minimum grade 4/C required.

subject_required: HL Maths Analysis and Approaches grade 5, or HL Maths Applications and Interpretation grade 6
additional_conditions: 18 points at Higher Level. Maths: Analysis and Approaches HL grade 5, OR Maths: Applications and Interpretation HL grade 6.
document_text: Leeds IB entry requires 18 points at Higher Level including grade 5 in HL Mathematics Analysis and Approaches, or grade 6 in HL Mathematics Applications and Interpretation. GCSE English Language minimum grade 4/C required.

headline_grade: H1 H2 H2 H2 H2 H2
document_text: Leeds Irish Leaving Certificate entry requires H1 H2 H2 H2 H2 H2 at Higher Level including Mathematics. GCSE English Language minimum grade 4/C required.

headline_grade: AA at Advanced Higher including Maths + AABBB at Higher
additional_conditions: AA at Advanced Higher level including Mathematics, plus AABBB at Higher level.
document_text: Leeds Scottish entry requires AA at Advanced Higher level including Mathematics, and AABBB at Higher level. GCSE English Language minimum grade 4/C required.

additional_conditions: Must pass Access to Leeds scheme. Eligible for students from low income households, first generation to apply to HE, or with disrupted studies. Up to 2 grades below standard offer.
document_text: Leeds Access to Leeds contextual scheme offers ABB including A in Mathematics for CS, compared to the standard AAA. This is up to 2 grades below the published entry requirement. Eligible students include those from low income households, first generation in their family to apply to higher education, or those who have had their studies disrupted. A pass in the Access to Leeds scheme is required. The programme also offers a study module, events and support to prepare for university.

additional_conditions: Applies automatically based on postcode. No separate application needed. Priority given to applications from Low Participation Neighbourhoods.
document_text: Leeds Low Participation Neighbourhood (LPN) scheme gives priority to applicants from neighbourhoods with low participation in higher education. If an offer is made, it may be reduced by one A level grade or equivalent in most cases. Students do not need to apply separately - Leeds automatically gives additional consideration to UCAS applications from LPN postcodes. Use the Leeds postcode checker to confirm eligibility.

headline_grade: Up to 2 grades below standard offer
additional_conditions: Two main routes: Access to Leeds scheme (up to 2 grades) and Low Participation Neighbourhood priority (1 grade). Foundation courses also available for those without formal qualifications.
document_text: Leeds contextual admissions has two main routes for UK students from underrepresented backgrounds. Access to Leeds offers up to 2 grades below the published entry requirement for eligible students. The Low Participation Neighbourhood scheme gives priority and typically 1 grade reduction for students from areas with low HE participation. Foundation courses are also available for students without formal qualifications for direct degree entry.
